topic.title: American Society of Indexers Recommended Indexing Agreement

body.p: American Society of Indexers (ASI)sample indexing agreement ASIAmerican Society of Indexers (ASI) Contractsformal vs. informal ContractsASI recommended agreement This appendix presents the text of the American Society of Indexers Recommended Indexing Agreement. This document is provided as a sample and may be adapted to suit the needs of individual projects.

section.title: Disclaimer
section.p: This indexing agreement is provided by the American Society of Indexers, Inc. for the information and use of indexers and publishers. The agreement is intended as a model and should be reviewed by legal counsel before use.

section.title: Assignment of Rights
section.p: Copyright assignment Work made for hire The agreement addresses whether the index is created as a work made for hire (in which case the publisher owns the copyright) or whether the indexer retains copyright and licenses specific rights to the publisher.

section.title: Author Credit and Editorial Approval
section.p: Indexer credit The agreement may specify whether the indexer will receive credit in the book’s acknowledgments or colophon. Editorial approval provisions establish who has final say over the content of the index.

section.title: Payment and Delivery
section.p: Payment terms Delivery terms Payment terms should be clearly specified, including the fee structure, when payment is due, and how the completed index will be delivered to the publisher.
